newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's October electrical output up 3.87 pct.
newsitem.headline: Peru's October electrical output up 3.87 pct.

text.p: Peru's electrical power output in October rose 3.87 percent to 1,383 gigawatt hours (GWh), compared with the same month last year, the Energy and Mines Ministry said Thursday.
Electrical power output in the first 10 months of the year was up 2.41 percent to 13,576 GWh, compared with the same period last year, according to a ministry report.
In October, public service firms produced 1,105 GWh while firms generating their own power produced the remaining 278 GWh of the country's total output.
In the first ten months, public service firms produced 10,835 GWh, while firms generating their own power produced the remaining 2,741 GWh.

State-run Electroperu, the largest of Peru's power- generating public service firms, produced 500 GWh in October, down 11.99 percent compared with the same month last year. The state company produced 5,263 GWh in the first ten months, off 14.6 percent.
